name: Snowbound

angles.text: Norric Lochthane's use of minor elemental couriers and frozen reagents reflects the shamanic traditions and elemental studies found in Khaz Modan.
Norric Lochthane and Grenhild's exchange offers a glimpse of dwarven mentorship and elemental scholarship around Loch Modan's peaks and shores.

faq.answer: Norric Lochthane is an experienced shaman who lives in a cottage on the northwest coast of the Loch in Loch Modan. He once taught Grenhild and still pursues shamanic workings in private. He can call on minor elementals to carry messages through the wilderness.

Grenhild is an elemental researcher stationed in Loch Modan. She studied magic under Norric Lochthane and respects his craft, but devotes her fieldwork to local elementals and has little time to travel.
Norric needs the snow for his shamanic workings and mystical research. He also hoped Grenhild would take the request as a reason to visit him in person.
faq.q: Why does Norric need a jar of snow?

aliases: how to get jar of snow
faq.answer: Gather snow near the tunnel entrance at South Gate Pass, high in the mountains between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan. The cold elevation keeps snow there throughout the year, so travelers can pack it in an insulated ceramic jar.
faq.q: Where is the snow gathered for this quest?

faq.answer: Grenhild is busy observing and studying Loch Modan's local elementals. Her fieldwork keeps her at her post, away from the trek to South Gate Pass and down to Norric's lakeside home.
faq.q: Why couldn't Grenhild deliver the snow herself?

faq.answer: Norric summoned a minor elemental and sent it to carry his message to Grenhild. The unusual courier shows his ease with elemental arts and shamanic practice.
faq.q: How did Norric send his request to Grenhild?

sections.body: Grenhild is studying Loch Modan's local elementals when a minor elemental arrives with a message from Norric Lochthane, her former mentor. He urgently needs fresh, unmelted snow for his shamanic workings. Grenhild asks a traveler to fetch it so she can stay with her studies. The snow comes from South Gate Pass, where cold drafts preserve the drifts year-round, and must be sealed in a specially crafted ceramic jar to keep the valley heat at bay.
sections.title: An Unusual Request

sections.body: Norric Lochthane lives in a quiet cottage on the Loch's northwest coast, away from the settlements. When the jar arrives, he is pleased to have the cold reagent for his mystical research. Yet he laments that Grenhild did not come herself. His request was for more than a magical ingredient: the aging shaman hoped to reconnect with his former student, now following her own path.
sections.title: Teacher and Pupil

summary: In Loch Modan, Grenhild studies the local elementals while Norric Lochthane asks for snow from South Gate Pass. His request carries a deeper hope: the aging shaman longs to see his former student again.
